7e032426c556c63248511e9064b92dcca9f165b5.translatedText: This count increases according to the number of scan processing times that enter the save branch\. For example, at a stable 20 Hz with normal processing per frame, 100 times is about 5 seconds, but interval itself is not a time parameter\. Locally, saving is performed in batches only when interval \> 0; 0 and other negative values also do not trigger periodic saving, and using the default special value \-1 is clearer\.
